description:
4 -8 years experience in developing Oracle Financial Applications in Accounting & Finance. Prior experience in Oracle Applications release R12 preferred. - Extensive technical knowledge in Virtual trader application with exposure to Intercompany accounting functionality. - Knowledge in Oracle Inventory, Purchasing and Order Management modules and tables. - Solid SQL & PLSQL skills, including knowledge of Oracle EBS table space for Financials. - Moderate functional knowledge of Oracle Financials modules (GL, AP, AR, FA, Projects) including setups and configurations. - Demonstrate expertise of process and technical aspects of Oracle Financials, specifically, module configurations, customizations, and seeded features/functionality. - Serve as an IT resource in all Accounting/Finance IT initiatives and perform duties such as requirements specifications, as-is and to-be documentation, user acceptance testing, developing training documentation and deploying the new solutions etc.


 Additional Info:
 Must be able to pass a background and drug screen
